claim: Route reports contain control names and types, never form values, and are not sent to our servers.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh profile; record a real input route on a URL with a query token, export it, and assert stored/exported data retains labels and roles but no input value, query token, fragment, title, or external report request

claim: Exports a route report with control names, types, order, and findings.
where: landing page, extension export button, README
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh profile; record real focused controls, start an observable JSON download, and assert labels, roles, browser order, and report data

claim: Demo sample data is separate from your real data, makes no external requests, and can be reset.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert only the demo: storage key exists before and after Reset demo, then assert Start for real removes it

claim: Free single-page reports can be exported without an account.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter /demo from the landing action and assert a sample report download without authentication

claim: Recording works offline after the page and extension are loaded.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; load the extension and a test page, set the browser offline, record a focused control, and assert the stored route

claim: The optional local report archive saves history only in this browser and does not sync or share reports.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; record a route, unlock the archive locally, save it, and assert one local archive record

claim: New local archive purchases are temporarily unavailable.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the landing page and assert the availability notice is visible and no team archive checkout link is offered

claim: Warns when a repeated forward Tab route returns to an earlier control.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; Tab through Alpha → Beta → Alpha and assert the exported route contains a loop finding

claim: Warns when a control lacks a visible focus indicator.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; Tab to a button with a transparent outline and assert an invisible-focus finding in the real report

claim: Records the browser's Tab order, including valid positive tabindex values.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in fresh browser profiles; Tab through tabindex=1, tabindex=2, and ordinary controls, then a checked native radio group, an implicit contenteditable control, and disabled/inert controls; assert each browser route has no skip finding

claim: Warns when a Tab move skips the next control in the browser's route.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; force Tab from Alpha to Gamma and assert a skip finding names expected Beta and actual Gamma

claim: Records real Shift+Tab moves in the reverse direction without treating ordinary backtracking as a loop.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; force Alpha to Gamma, press Shift+Tab through Beta to Alpha, and assert both moves are reverse with no loop finding

claim: Shows page labels as text in the extension popup.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh browser profile; focus a control whose aria-label contains button markup and assert the popup creates no injected control

claim: A returned local-archive license can be copied into the extension for verification.
sandbox: fresh browser profile; open the companion site with a checkout-return license, assert the token is shown after URL cleanup, paste it into the packed extension, stub the documented verification response, and assert local archive access

claim: License checks go only to the Sociobot billing API.
sandbox: packed MV3 extension in a fresh profile; verify a local-archive license and assert the only external request is the documented Sociobot verification endpoint
